clips.title: The story
paras: Jern Hornhelm is a dwarven miner affiliated with the Explorers' League, stationed in the town of Thelsamar. He coordinates vital logistics and communication between the settlement, Ironforge, and the archaeological dig site deeper in Loch Modan. Adventurers frequently assist him with shuttling mining supplies and progress reports across the region.

Stationed within the rustic town of Thelsamar, Jern Hornhelm plays a key logistical role for dwarven operations throughout Loch Modan. While dwarven scholars and field teams venture out into the wilderness to unearth their ancestral past, maintaining consistent supply chains remains essential. Jern ensures that vital resources, tools, and communications reach the active dig sites safely.
